score_record_coverage.computation_rule: explicit point_winner player/opponent records / all supplied point rows; video time is not required.

recorded_point_wins.computation_rule: counts only explicit player/opponent winners; it does not assert match identity or match completion.

time_range_coverage.computation_rule: known-winner point rows with both endpoints range-checked against user-reported duration / known-winner rows; timestamps remain UNBOUND.

timeline_bound_review_coverage.computation_rule: quick annotation never binds source SHA, timeline_id, PTS, or time_base; no row is counted as confirmed video-reviewable.

server_point_win_rate.computation_rule: known serving-side wins / rows with both serving side and point winner known.

receiver_point_win_rate.computation_rule: known receiving-side wins / rows with both receiving side and point winner known.

serve_side.computation_rule: category counts for explicitly observed serve_side; unknown/unclear excluded from denominator and not_applicable is reported separately.

serve_length.computation_rule: category counts for explicitly observed serve_length; unknown/unclear excluded from denominator and not_applicable is reported separately.

serve_location.computation_rule: category counts for explicitly observed serve_location; unknown/unclear excluded from denominator and not_applicable is reported separately.

serve_spin.computation_rule: category counts for explicitly observed serve_spin; unknown/unclear excluded from denominator and not_applicable is reported separately.

receive_type.computation_rule: category counts for explicitly observed receive_type; unknown/unclear excluded from denominator and not_applicable is reported separately.

receive_location.computation_rule: category counts for explicitly observed receive_location; unknown/unclear excluded from denominator and not_applicable is reported separately.

third_ball_attack.computation_rule: category counts for explicitly observed third_ball_attack; unknown/unclear excluded from denominator and not_applicable is reported separately.

third_ball_side.computation_rule: category counts for explicitly observed third_ball_side; unknown/unclear excluded from denominator and not_applicable is reported separately.

third_ball_outcome.computation_rule: category counts for explicitly observed third_ball_outcome; unknown/unclear excluded from denominator and not_applicable is reported separately.

rally_length.computation_rule: sum of explicitly observed exact rally_length values / number of exact observed values; no stage bucket is converted to exact length.

third_ball_attack_rate.computation_rule: explicit third_ball_attack=yes / explicitly classified yes-or-no rows; unknown/unclear do not enter the denominator.

third_ball_immediate_success.computation_rule: explicit successful third_ball_outcome / explicitly successful-or-unsuccessful outcomes among observed attack=yes rows; this is not the point-win rate.

third_ball_server_point_conversion.computation_rule: serving-side wins / explicitly observed third_ball_attack=yes rows with known server and winner; remains a human-draft observation.

key_point_player_win_rate.computation_rule: player wins / known winners among rule-derived close-score candidates; candidate status is not independent confirmation.

rally_stage_distribution.computation_rule: Counts only explicitly supplied coarse user-observed stage buckets; no exact rally_length, third-ball action, or outcome is inferred.

review_candidates.limitation: Compare the explicit draft labels with the actual source only after match/source identity and timeline are independently verified.

limitations: These are descriptive statistics over explicit quick-draft rows; they are not an audited training report.
Known point winners remain in score counts even when timestamps are absent or unbound.
Range-checked timestamps do not establish source identity, timeline binding, PTS, or time_base.
Unknown and unclear tactical values are excluded from known-technique denominators and counted as missing.
Sample caution threshold is a product display rule only; it is not a significance test and does not support causal claims.
No Vision analysis or independently verified video evidence is claimed.
